newsitem.title: LATVIA: BANK ASSOCIATION LAUNCHES NEW TOP-20 RATING.
newsitem.headline: BANK ASSOCIATION LAUNCHES NEW TOP-20 RATING.

text.p: The Latvian Commercial Bank Association said on Wednesday that it had launched a new top-twenty bank rating.

The ratings are modeled on Euromoney magazine's system, which uses indicators such as return on capital, return of assets, net interest margin, profit before tax, capital adequacy, and annual average assets.

"We think this is a better rating as ranging banks by their asset size and related criteria shows how efficiently they use their capital," Zanete Glaudina, an analyst with the association, told Reuters.
"The previous 1995 rating ranged banks according to their capital, which means that the 1995 and 1996 ratings provided by the association are not comparable," she added.
Points are assigned for each indicator and the total is 100.
The banks included in the list are divided into three groups according to their asset size: above 40 million lats; from 10 to 40 million lats; and below 10 million lats.
Parekss Bank, Unibanka and Rietumu Bank are the top three.
